title: monotile-ca: cellular automata on the hat and spectre aperiodic monotilings
description:
The toolchain, search drivers, and complete replayable result set behind the paper Gliders on Aperiodic Monotilings: Cellular Automata on the Hat and Spectre (James Edmond, 2026) and its companion interactive essay. Patch generation on the hat, spectre and Penrose tilings from finite-state transducers (Tatham), a no_std graph cellular-automaton engine compiled natively and to WebAssembly, exhaustive and evolutionary rule-space search with structural anti-gaming controls, cross-radius verification, and the constant-memory sliding-window tracker that flew the discovered gliders to a million rings. Every result record replays exactly from a small tuple.

Code is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the archive lists MIT; either applies).
